purpose: Long-running maintenance plan for unattended repository work

long_term_goal.objective: Correctly diagnose and process every aircraft in the user's installed MSFS catalog wherever the package contains usable source data; explicitly identify missing or unsupported source features rather than guessing.
long_term_goal.cycle: Alternate compatibility work and GUI work; after every stage run a focused architecture/code review, record newly found issues, and update this roadmap before starting the next stage.

steps: create a focused codex/* branch from the current integration base
run local checks and real-catalog measurement
wait for CI; merge only after checks
publish a versioned release from the integrated main branch when release criteria are met
stage_workflow.release_rule: Use patch releases for user-visible compatible fixes and feature releases for a coherent larger capability; never label unmerged branch artifacts as a release.
stage_workflow.cycle: Alternate compatibility breadth and user workflow/GUI work; after each stage run focused and independent architecture reviews, update the roadmap, and continue with the next stage without waiting for a release milestone.

stages.name: Resolver diagnostics and gated release automation
deliverables: shared package-index history-stub policy
stable machine-readable dependency causes

stages.result: Removed four false DA62 inheritance ambiguities caused by a shadowed fs-base-history stub. Deep local scan: 233 aircraft, 226 geometry-buildable, 48 partial; 0 ambiguous links; 89 missing-base causes (45 base links plus 44 model references), 4 declared model files absent from installed bases, 60 optional texture fallbacks. Added problem_code to new resolver dependencies while retaining text fallback for older catalog JSON. 170 tests, GUI self-test and compileall pass. Release workflow syntax has been reviewed statically; actionlint/YAML parser are unavailable in this environment. Committed as d4218ff and pushed to origin/codex/release-pipeline; PR/release remains blocked by GitHub integration 403.
stages.next: Commit/push this stage, then take a GUI workflow stage around reviewing candidate models for the four declared-but-missing model references; independently inspect feature gaps and regression risks before choosing the following compatibility stage.

stages.result: Added model_choices.source_gaps for unresolved external model declarations. GUI now states the missing role and filename and explains that a chosen base-package candidate is a manual substitute; it does not mark it correct automatically. Synthetic tests pass, and a real Pitts livery check showed missing S1_Interior.xml with an available S1_Interior_LOD01.gltf from the installed base. 171 tests, GUI self-test and compileall pass.
stages.next: Start M10 compatibility-source audit: investigate unresolved optional texture fallbacks and distinguish resources truly absent from paths hidden in package layouts; do not loosen optional/required semantics.

stages.name: Compatibility audit and resolver gaps
deliverables: re-measure all installed model references after M9
separate genuinely absent source from resolver gaps
fix highest-impact reproducible package-resolution issue with fixtures
stages.acceptance: Deep catalog has no unexplained false missing dependency among resolvable installed packages; every remaining blocked class has a concrete user action or explicit unsupported-source diagnosis.
stages.result: Deep-catalog audit checked all 60 unresolved texture fallbacks against the installed package index: 51 explicitly target aircraft folders absent from all scanned roots; 9 reference generic fallback folders with no installed owner. 47 of 60 are attached to aircraft with an unresolved base_container; 13 are attached to an aircraft with a base present but refer to another missing optional target. No exact target aircraft folder existed in the index, so no false negative in VFS rebase was found. Added target_aircraft and target_aircraft_installed metadata, a dedicated optional_texture_target_aircraft_missing compatibility class and GUI next-step guidance. Real C172 AS1000 diagnosis now says Asobo_C172SP_Classic is absent from selected roots and the fallback does not block geometry. 174 tests, GUI self-test and compileall pass.
stages.next: Push M10 then begin M11 on a fresh GUI branch: make scanned package roots visible/manageable so a user can tell which Official, Community, and custom roots participated in dependency resolution; audit branch/release workflow and existing GUI behavior before settling implementation.

stages.acceptance: CLI roots, repeated --root, settings migration and GUI manager pass tests; a two-root installed catalog/index run has no duplicates or hidden errors; docs explain the flow.
stages.result: Added CLI `roots`, a GUI manager separating system-detected roots and manually added roots, repeatable --root propagation through catalog, index, inventory, models and missing-texture search, legacy msfs_root migration, removal of missing custom roots, and bilingual user/wiki docs. Synthetic tests cover root migration, missing paths and command forwarding. Real two-root index: 526 packages, 233 aircraft names, 0 index errors. 179 tests, GUI self-test, compileall and diff checks pass.
stages.next: Push M11; start M12 with an ownership audit of unresolved base_container and model paths. Check alternate package manifests and resource roots before concluding a source is absent. Then review the root manager with the measured diagnosis and user-facing gaps in M13.

stages.name: Audit unresolved base-aircraft and model ownership
deliverables: measure all unresolved base_container/model references by package and manifest
check whether exact model sources exist in indexed packages under alternate ownership
fix any reproducible false misses; keep genuinely absent sources clearly diagnosed
stages.acceptance: No unresolved base/model link has an installed exact owner that the resolver fails to find; remaining missing sources are classified as absent, malformed, or unsupported.
stages.result: Audited all 45 unresolved base_container records (12 unique base names) against every resolved manifest dependency package, exact aircraft folder, and declared model XML; no installed exact owner or source was found. Deep catalog: 233 aircraft, 226 geometry-buildable, 48 partial, 526 indexed packages, 0 index errors. Compatibility snapshot now distinguishes unresolved record counts from unique target counts: base_container 12, model 1, texture_fallback 18; 89 missing-base causes, 4 declared model files absent, 60 optional texture fallbacks. Added target fallback handling and regression coverage. 179 unit tests, GUI self-test, compileall and path-free snapshot regeneration pass.
stages.next: Start M13 on a fresh branch: audit the multi-root GUI and dependency actions, then test new/open/reopen and legacy settings migration. Independently review validation and user-facing error paths before the next compatibility stage.

stages.name: GUI root and dependency diagnostics review

stages.acceptance: A user can tell what roots are searched, which roots are missing, and what dependency action to take without editing project JSON.
stages.result: Reviewed saved-root migration, catalog-root forwarding, manual-root removal, missing-path warnings, callback failure handling, and malformed roots responses. The manager now summarizes effective, automatic, manual and missing root counts; refresh failures show a plain-language message and put technical details in the Log tab. Render is safe for absent/malformed response lists. 181 unit tests, GUI self-test, compileall and diff checks pass; bilingual user guides updated.
stages.next: Alternate back to compatibility: validate generated build plans across all currently buildable installed-aircraft records, classify any worker/config blockers, and turn the report into reproducible tests. Follow with a GUI repair/diagnosis flow only for errors this audit proves can be fixed without guessing.

stages.name: Installed aircraft build-plan coverage audit
deliverables: exercise the normal geometry build-plan preflight for every geometry-buildable catalog record
classify plan failures by source/layout/config cause and distinguish expected partials
add a path-free reproducible coverage report and fixtures for every discovered failure class
stages.acceptance: Every installed catalog record marked geometry-buildable either yields a validated plan or a stable actionable blocker; no mass Blender builds are launched automatically.
stages.result: Added `audit-plans`, a plan-only audit that shares one package index across a deep catalog and normal geometry preflight; it never launches Blender or writes .blend files. Real installation: 233 catalog records, 226 geometry-buildable, 226/226 plans validated, 0 rejected, 0 index errors. The first run exposed AS-33 declaring the same glTF for exterior and interior; resolver defaults and model.cfg loading now deduplicate that source once, preferring exterior, preventing a duplicate import and correcting the false build-plan failure. 183 tests, GUI self-test, compileall and diff checks pass. Visual Blender output remains outside this preflight.
stages.next: Expose the plan-only audit in the GUI with a concise result and per-aircraft failure list; test multi-root forwarding and error/success feedback. Then select the next compatibility gap from a fresh scan.

stages.name: GUI build-plan diagnosis and repair routing
deliverables: show plan-preflight blockers before starting Blender

stages.acceptance: A user can identify whether a package needs a source root, model selection, supported mode change, or source restoration before running the worker.
stages.result: Added a GUI toolbar button that calls `audit-plans` with all saved package roots. The UI shows analysis progress, a compact success count, rejected aircraft/problem codes, and directs the user to package diagnosis. It handles malformed JSON without a traceback. 187 tests, GUI self-test, compileall and diff checks pass.
stages.next: Expand compatibility validation to the user’s previously analyzed local community aircraft folders (Wilga, Zenith 701, K21, SG38 and Antonov An-2), plus additional-root package layouts. Use the plan-only CLI and classify any failures before changing the resolver.

stages.acceptance: Every geometry-buildable representative source currently present locally yields a plan; missing requested roots are listed and cannot be mistaken for a complete pass.
stages.result: The five historical mod folders were checked: only the Antonov An-2 download remains present; Wilga, Zenith 701, K21 and SG38 are absent from the noted Downloads locations and were not substituted. Package-root audit including An-2: 237 catalog entries, 230 geometry-buildable, 230/230 valid plans, 0 index errors. Direct An-2 Wheels aircraft-folder root: 234 catalog entries, 227/227 valid plans. A deliberately missing root reports scope_complete=false and exits 2. Added regression and GUI handling for missing roots; no aircraft files or .blend files were modified. 189 tests, GUI self-test, compileall and diff checks pass.
stages.next: Improve GUI recovery after the audit: make missing-root results open the root manager and rejected aircraft selectable in the catalog, then verify the chosen aircraft diagnosis/model chooser action. Keep the audit read-only.
